problem: Periodic freezes / frametime spikes every 2-10 s caused by Realtek 2.5GbE / PCIe GbE Family Controller (Vanguard + Realtek LAN driver)
symptoms: Game/audio freeze 0.2-0.5 s every 2-5 (or 3, 5, 10) seconds, FPS drops to 0
CPU/GPU frametime spikes only in Valorant (and EAC games)
USB-disconnect chime and stutter ~1 min after launch (vgm.exe 0xc0000409 errors in Event Viewer)
Event Viewer shows Realtek LAN driver errors (e.g. rt25cx21) or constant disconnect spam
Common on AMD (Ryzen 7000/9000) + Gigabyte/ASRock/MSI boards with a Realtek 2.5GbE NIC
root_causes: Bug between the Realtek 2.5GbE/GbE Family Controller driver and Vanguard anti-cheat causing CPU/GPU frame time spikes (not fixed by driver updates for everyone)

fixes.fix: Device Manager > Network adapters > right-click 'Realtek Gaming 2.5GbE Family Controller' / 'Realtek PCIe GbE Family Controller' / 'Realtek PCIe 10GbE/5GbE Family Controller' > Disable device (play on Wi-Fi; if on Ethernet disable the Wi-Fi adapter or a second unused LAN port instead; one user also had to disable onboard LAN in BIOS)
Update the 2.5GbE adapter driver from the motherboard manufacturer (reduced freezing but not the Event Viewer disconnect spam)
Follow the r/AMDHelp 'ultimate AMD performance fix' guide steps (5, 9, 11, 12 etc. - step 12 is the Realtek fix)

diagnostic_signals: Network adapter list: present+enabled Realtek 2.5GbE/GbE Family Controller
Event Viewer System/Application: Realtek NIC driver errors (rt25cx21), adapter disconnect/reconnect events, vgm.exe Application Error 1000 exception 0xc0000409
Whether the active connection is Wi-Fi (safe to disable LAN adapter) or Ethernet

problem: PC hard freeze/black screen requiring power-button reset while Valorant runs - USB Selective Suspend / USB controller
symptoms: Entire PC freezes 1-3 min into Valorant (mouse/keyboard dead, audio buzz or loop), only a forced shutdown helps
Only Valorant triggers it; often started after a patch/GPU driver update
Freeze/crash also on restart/shutdown after playing (AM5/X870 boards)
root_causes: USB selective suspend / peripheral USB controller power management conflicts, notably with chipset-attached USB ports on AM5/X870 boards

fixes.fix: Control Panel > Hardware and Sound > Power Options > Change plan settings > Change advanced power settings > USB settings > USB selective suspend setting > Disabled (several users report it fixed multi-year freezes - a non-OP commenter said 'worked for me'; one OP kept it and stayed stable; Riot support recommended it per one commenter)

Plug mouse and keyboard into USB ports wired directly to the CPU, not chipset ports (fixed freeze on shutdown/restart after Valorant on MSI X870 + 9800X3D, reported by commenter); also check XHCI hand-off enabled in BIOS
Lower mouse polling rate / uninstall Logitech G HUB (single commenters)

diagnostic_signals: powercfg: USB selective suspend setting value for the active plan
Event Viewer Kernel-Power 41 / unexpected shutdown after game session
Mouse/keyboard connected to chipset vs CPU USB root hub

problem: Valorant crashing/freezing whole PC fixed by updating motherboard BIOS
symptoms: Valorant freezes then crashes the PC ~2 min after launch, forced restart needed
DDU driver reinstall, Windows reinstall, Vanguard reinstall did not help
AMD GPU (RX 9060 XT) on MSI board
root_causes: Outdated BIOS/AGESA incompatible with Vanguard

fixes.fix: Download the latest BIOS for your exact motherboard from the vendor site and flash it (OP confirmed after trying driver rollback and Windows reinstall)
Update BIOS suggested by others for general stability; another OP's BIOS update only helped temporarily (7500F/9060XT)

diagnostic_signals: BIOS version/date from Win32_BIOS vs latest vendor release
Event Viewer Kernel-Power 41 / reliability history critical events

problem: Vanguard requirement not met: HVCI / Memory Integrity (Core isolation) disabled - causes game freezes/restarts and 'Windows build 19045 or newer' error
symptoms: Error: 'Your account does not meet the following requirements: Windows build 19045 or newer, HVCI enabled'
PC restarts or freezes during/after matches; accounts AFK-penalised
Core isolation toggle greyed out
root_causes: Windows build too old (below 22H2 build 19045)
Memory integrity (HVCI/VBS) off, or hardware virtualization (Intel VT-x / AMD SVM) disabled in BIOS

fixes.fix: Update Windows to the latest version (Windows 10 22H2 build 19045 via Windows Update/Update Assistant) then Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation > Memory integrity = On

Enable Core isolation/Memory integrity; if toggle unavailable enable Intel Virtualization Technology (VT-x) or AMD SVM Mode in BIOS; also IOMMU/VBS per Riot Vanguard Restrictions page (author fixed months of PC freezes this way)
Enable core isolation / memory integrity (suggested for random freezes and restarts)

problem: Valorant freezes whole system when iGPU disabled in BIOS / secure boot keys corrupted
symptoms: Entire system freezes 1-3 minutes after opening Valorant on a new Ryzen 7000 build (7800X3D / 7500F), only reset helps
root_causes: Vanguard misbehaves with integrated GPU disabled on some AMD systems
Corrupted/missing Secure Boot keys

fixes.fix: Enable the integrated GPU (iGPU) in BIOS (costs ~512 MB RAM) - OP confirmed
Reset Secure Boot keys / restore factory keys in BIOS - a commenter reported it fixed identical freezing

diagnostic_signals: Secure Boot state and key enrolment (Confirm-SecureBootUEFI)

problem: Laptop freezing during Valorant - power plan / GPU clock
symptoms: Random full-laptop freeze with audio buzz, forced reboot needed, MSI Katana RTX 4060
root_causes: Balanced power plan / factory-overclocked laptop GPU

fixes.fix: Set power plan to High performance (OP: played 3-5 h with no freeze); newest GPU drivers
Reduce GPU clock/undervolt to base speed in vendor software

problem: Low/dropping FPS on laptop or after GPU swap due to power limit or thermal throttling
symptoms: FPS 40-60 instead of 300-400 after laptop used for hours
FPS 100-140 after GPU upgrade with low CPU/GPU usage (40%)
Intel Core 7 240H laptop dynamic power max stuck at 10W
root_causes: CPU thermal throttling from poor airflow/cooling
Laptop CPU power limit (dynamic power max) stuck at 10 W

fixes.fix: Fix cooling and airflow (clean dust, improve ventilation) - FPS 100-140 -> 350+
Found via HWiNFO that dynamic power max was 10W; installed ThrottleStop to override power limits (OP; also tried other HDMI port)
Use cooling pad, undervolt
Disable Windows Fast Startup
After GPU swap: DDU the old vendor driver then install new (170-200 FPS from 100-140)

diagnostic_signals: CPU temperature and clock vs max during load
CPU power limit PL1/PL2 / throttle reason
Power plan and battery vs AC
Leftover old GPU vendor drivers (NVIDIA after swapping to AMD)

problem: Sudden FPS drop/freeze after Valorant patch caused by Overwolf / Valorant Tracker overlay
symptoms: FPS capped or dropped to 25-60 (from 250-800) for no reason after tabbing out/after update
Game freezes 5-10 s after alt-tab back into the game
Only on some accounts after a recent patch
root_causes: Overwolf / Valorant Tracker overlay conflicts with the game after a patch

fixes.fix: Fully close Overwolf and Valorant Tracker (kill from Task Manager) before launching; or only turn off the Overwolf in-game overlay (tracker keeps working) - multiple users confirmed
Close Riot Client from Task Manager and relaunch (one OP's fix for the alt-tab freeze)
Press F11 right after the game freezes on alt-tab to toggle fullscreen

diagnostic_signals: Running processes: Overwolf.exe, OverwolfBrowser, Valorant Tracker, other overlays (Medal, Discord, Radeon overlay)

problem: Stutter/freezes caused by overlays or background software (Nvidia overlay, Xbox Game Bar, Radeon overlay, Windows theme slideshow)
symptoms: Game freezes and FPS drops to 80-90 during util-heavy moments
Micro-stutter on AMD GPU
Freeze every ~3 s from rotating wallpaper theme
root_causes: Overlays/background services hooking the game

fixes.fix: Turn off NVIDIA overlay and Xbox Game Bar (OP confirmed no more freezes)
Disable Radeon overlay 'optimisation' settings (OP confirmed all stutters gone)
Disable Discord GPU acceleration/overlay (tried by one, didn't help); stop Windows wallpaper/theme slideshow changing
Clean boot to find background app
Full screen -> windowed fixed stutter for one user

diagnostic_signals: Running overlay processes (GameBar, NVIDIA overlay, Radeon software overlay, Discord overlay, MSI Afterburner, Medal)

problem: Shader-cache / driver-settings stutter on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs
symptoms: Stutter after updating GPU driver (every ~1 s)
Valorant on RX 9060 XT / 9070 XT feels unsmooth, gets better with play
Low FPS and 40% GPU usage after GPU swap
Sudden hitching on RX 6600
root_causes: Shader cache rebuild after driver update
AMD driver features (Anti-Lag, AFMF, FSR upscaling on) interfering
Residual old-vendor drivers

fixes.fix: Play for a while to let shaders recompile; DDU old drivers; ensure Anti-Lag off for Valorant, turn off AMD Fluid Motion Frames / FSR upscaling
DDU downgrade to stable driver (e.g. NVIDIA 581.94)
Disable Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO) in registry and set Shader Cache to 'Always On' in AMD software
Follow r/AMDHelp performance guide: step 2 registry tweak, 8, 11-A
Nvidia Control Panel > Adjust image settings > Balanced/Best performance (OP: FPS improved on Ryzen 5600 + RTX 5060)

problem: Packet loss / rubber-banding on EU servers fixed by changing NVIDIA driver version
symptoms: Choppy movement, 50-90 ms to Frankfurt/Warsaw, thousands of lost packets in ranked
Started with a newer NVIDIA driver (595.97) on RTX 5080 laptop; other games fine
root_causes: Incompatibility between certain NVIDIA drivers and Vanguard/netcode

fixes.fix: Roll back NVIDIA driver (OP: 595.79 stable; others cited 576.80) - OP later said problem returned and deleted post

problem: Network desync/teleporting due to dual network adapters (external Wi-Fi antenna vs onboard)
symptoms: Rubber-banding, teleporting, animations not playing, desync with low ping
root_causes: Windows switched priority between onboard Wi-Fi and external antenna adapter; adapter flip-flopping mid-game

fixes.fix: Disable the unused/weaker Wi-Fi adapter in Device Manager and fix adapter priority (OP confirmed)

problem: VAN 72 / VAN 185 connection errors - Wi-Fi randomly connecting while on Ethernet
symptoms: VAN 72 in Event Viewer, then VAN 185 after disabling Wi-Fi (cleared after restart)
root_causes: Wi-Fi adapter intermittently connecting alongside Ethernet

fixes.fix: Disable Wi-Fi adapter in Device Manager when playing on Ethernet, restart (no errors for a week)

diagnostic_signals: Both Ethernet and Wi-Fi adapters up

problem: VAL 185 / VAN 102 recurrent connection error requiring restart
symptoms: Error recurs every 1-2 games; needs full restart; escalating queue penalty
root_causes: Vanguard service state breaks (unknown)

fixes.fix: Without rebooting: Task Manager end Valorant, Vanguard user-mode service and vanguard tray; run C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgtray.exe; relaunch game

problem: Vanguard stuck in 'Preparing download' / Update-Play loop, will not install
symptoms: Riot Client cycles Update -> Preparing download -> Play -> Update
Vanguard never appears in tray
Repair loop: Valorant repairs for 1 s then returns to Play
root_causes: Corrupted/partial Vanguard install, vgc/vgk services left over
Riot Client minimising to tray setting
Outdated Windows 10 build
ARM64 Windows unsupported
Corrupted drive

fixes.fix: Admin cmd: sc delete vgc ; sc delete vgk ; reboot ; delete C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard ; reopen Riot Client and reinstall Vanguard, reboot
Uninstall Riot Vanguard from Settings > Apps, restart, relaunch Riot Client to reinstall
Riot Client: Valorant > Repair, then Update; in general settings switch 'minimize to system tray' to 'Exit application' and restart client (OP confirmed)
Click Update and spam Pause during 'Preparing' 2-3 times
Install LoL client Vanguard link before login
Update Windows 10 to latest feature version (Update Assistant)
netsh winsock reset + ipconfig /flushdns then restart
If Windows on ARM, Vanguard unsupported
Reinstall game on a different drive when repair loops (original drive failed later)

diagnostic_signals: vgc/vgk service registration and Riot Vanguard folder state

problem: VAL 79 / VAN 79 - vgc service not running
symptoms: VAL 79 after game update
VAN-79 after Windows reinstall; set vgc automatic did not help
root_causes: vgc service stopped/manual start
Windows Insider/Canary build not tolerated by Vanguard

fixes.fix: Uninstall Riot Vanguard, reinstall via Riot Client, restart, services.msc > start vgc and set Startup type Automatic (confirmed by a commenter)
Roll back from Insider/Canary to stable Windows (OP's conclusion)

problem: BSOD KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE (0x139) / vgk.sys crash on Windows Insider (26H1) when Vanguard installs
symptoms: Black/green screen KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE 0x139 right after installing Vanguard
Windows freezes after Vanguard install and reboot
SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED vgk.sys
root_causes: Vanguard driver incompatible with Windows 11 26H1 / Insider build 29560
Secure Boot disabled (dual-boot) with vgk loaded

fixes.fix: Boot recovery/safe mode and delete C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgk.sys (or whole folder / disable via Autoruns) instead of reinstalling Windows
Use stable Windows 25H2 (vhdx dual boot worked); later Insider build 29570 + Riot LoL patch of 2026-04-14 also worked
Enable Secure Boot + TPM 2.0 and reinstall Vanguard (OP fix for vgk.sys 0x7E after Linux dual boot)
Reinstall Windows to remove Vanguard

problem: Secure Boot: boot failure or 'Invalid signature detected' after enabling
symptoms: Stuck at Lenovo logo 'Default boot device missing' after enabling Secure Boot
Gigabyte B550: 'Invalid signature detected, check Secure Boot policy'
Black screen after disabling CSM
VAN 1 restriction on old BIOS
root_causes: Wrong/missing Secure Boot platform keys
CSM/MBR disk instead of UEFI/GPT

fixes.fix: In BIOS disable Secure Boot, restore factory keys, answer No when prompted to exit, re-enable Secure Boot, F10 save (OP confirmed on Gigabyte B550 UD AC)
Use default platform keys in BIOS; Windows reinstall as last resort (confirmed by one user)
Convert MBR disk to GPT (mbr2gpt) before disabling CSM and enabling Secure Boot
Update BIOS (VAN 1 on 2020 BIOS)

problem: TPM Event ID 14/17 errors with Windows device chime on AMD AM5 boards
symptoms: Device connect/disconnect chime, Device Manager refresh, TPM Event 14/17 when Valorant runs; CPU spike; PC crash on shutdown
root_causes: fTPM/chipset USB interaction on AM5/X870 boards with Vanguard; dTPM not accepted when CPU has fTPM

fixes.fix: Disable USB selective suspend and put peripherals on CPU-direct USB ports (commenter confirmed crash/freeze stopped)
Update chipset driver and set vgc to Automatic
Install discrete dTPM module (worked for one, failed for others; Vanguard may reject dTPM)

diagnostic_signals: TPM event IDs 14/17 in System log

problem: Game stuck on loading screen / VAL 43 caused by third-party mDNS software (National Instruments, Bonjour, Apple)
symptoms: Splash screen bar stuck at ~10% and VAL 43; task manager slow
Event Viewer Application error: Faulting module nimdnsResponder.dll / mdnsNSP.dll
root_causes: NI/Apple/Bonjour mDNS responder DLL injected into Valorant networking process

fixes.fix: Event Viewer > Windows Logs > Application: find faulting module; uninstall National Instruments software (or disable its auto updater); uninstall Apple Bonjour (mdnsNSP.dll)
Alt-tab to File Explorer right after the splash appears; compat mode/admin/disable fullscreen optimisations on exe
A linked Reddit thread's fix for loading-screen hang (content not shown) / fresh Windows install also fixed one

diagnostic_signals: Installed software: National Instruments, Bonjour/Apple mDNS
Event Log faulting module nimdnsResponder.dll or mdnsNSP.dll

problem: VAN restriction / error 5 / 102 kick - Razer Synapse game escalation service
symptoms: Kicked from games after 1-2 matches with error 5 or 102
root_causes: Razer Synapse service conflicting and shutting down VGC

fixes.fix: Disable Razer Synapse's game escalation service and reset Valorant profile cache (author; others without Synapse still affected)

problem: Valorant crashes on agent select/range - run exe as administrator / disable fullscreen optimisation
symptoms: Valorant closes immediately on agent select/range with no error
root_causes: Fullscreen optimisations/permission issue

fixes.fix: Riot Games\VALORANT\live\ShooterGame\Binaries\Win64\VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe > Properties > Compatibility: Disable fullscreen optimizations + Run as administrator; run Riot Client as admin (OP confirmed)

problem: Valorant crashes when streaming with TikTok Live Studio game capture
symptoms: Fullscreen Valorant freezes then crashes when TikTok Live Studio game capture starts; windowed OK
root_causes: Game Capture source hooking Valorant

fixes.fix: Close/reopen TikTok Live Studio, switch Valorant to windowed, add Display Capture, return to fullscreen (OP confirmed)
Use Window Capture source or OBS with Aitum Vertical plugin feeding TikTok Studio

problem: Graphics driver crash in DX11 fixed by Windows 11 upgrade
symptoms: 'Graphics drivers crashed' once per game within 5-10 min on Windows 10
root_causes: DX11 problem on Windows 10

fixes.fix: Upgrade Windows 10 to Windows 11 (guide author)
AMDHelp guide steps 2, 13, 14

problem: XINPUT1_3.dll / DirectX runtime error launching Valorant
symptoms: XINPUT1_3.dll not designed to run in Windows ; DirectX runtime required
root_causes: Corrupt xinput DLL copy

fixes.fix: Delete the xinput file (xinput1_3.dll) from C drive (OP, fixed Valorant and Steam games; exact path not given)

problem: Stretched resolution black bars / Fill not working
symptoms: 4:3 stretched (1280x960/1440x1080) shows black bars; Fill reverts after each match
NVIDIA Control Panel has no scaling options on laptop with Intel iGPU
root_causes: GPU scaling option lost after update/driver change

fixes.fix: Per match: turn off custom res, go fullscreen, apply Fill; then windowed borderless Fill; then turn on custom res without pressing Fill (workaround, author)
Do NOT use config-file 'properties > notes' trick - got account temporarily suspended

diagnostic_signals: Display scaling setting in NVIDIA/Intel control panel

problem: FPS lower than benchmarks / hardware limit / FPS caps
symptoms: ~100-300 FPS vs YouTube benchmarks of 350-450 on mid hardware
Lag fixed unexpectedly by capping menu FPS
root_causes: Valorant is CPU single-core bound; benchmarks use range/deathmatch; mismatched RAM

fixes.fix: Expect lower FPS in real matches; enable XMP/EXPO, High performance plan, Resizable BAR, lock FPS cap and Reflex
Check all three FPS cap values (gameplay, background, menu)
Set menu FPS cap to 30 (author confirmed it removed lag; another user suggested it for frame drops)

problem: Vanguard User Mode Service high CPU
symptoms: vgc uses up to 50% CPU and causes spikes
root_causes: Windows Defender scanning Riot folders

fixes.fix: Exclude Valorant, Riot Client and Vanguard folders from Defender

problem: Mouse issues: wired-mouse cursor flicker; high polling rate lag in fullscreen
symptoms: Cursor appears/blinks pre-round when jumping; 2k polling in fullscreen drops FPS in smoke menus
root_causes: Wired mouse interference; polling rate vs menu

fixes.fix: Switch to wireless mouse (OP)
Use 1k polling; connect to CPU-direct USB; enable XHCI hand-off

problem: Blurry weapon skins
symptoms: Skins blurry in play but clear in inspect
root_causes: Anisotropic filtering at 1x / control-panel overrides

fixes.fix: Increase anisotropic filtering to 4x (OP)
Reset Nvidia Control Panel to defaults

problem: Account MFA keeps prompting
symptoms: MFA activated but 'Activate' still shows
root_causes: Email not linked as account login

fixes.fix: Link the original Gmail in Linked Accounts (OP)

problem: Chat service unavailable / matches hang after agent select
symptoms: Chat service error, stuck after agent select, VPN helped game load only
root_causes: ISP routing issue

fixes.fix: Use Cloudflare WARP

problem: Audio level change / Bluetooth earbuds mode
symptoms: Game audio quiet and low quality; Bluetooth earbuds in call mode
root_causes: Exclusive mode / Bluetooth hands-free profile

fixes.fix: Turn off 'Allow applications to take exclusive control' in Windows sound device settings

diagnostic_signals: Default playback device is Bluetooth hands-free

problem: Black screen/freeze with volmgr 161; GPU fan stuck at 100% after Vanguard first install
symptoms: Black screen at launch freezes laptop on one account
GPU fans 100% after Vanguard first install
root_causes: unknown / Vanguard first-run scan

fixes.fix: Check Event Viewer for volmgr 161
Fan issue went away after 4 reboots
